digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Tuesday, November 24. Danny's skip-level and the afternoon portfolio discussions anchor eight meetings, with seven carried-over items and one urgent carry-over. Prioritize the SMS outage, Wave 2 readiness and the RFE MHE decisions; resolve the 11:30 AM and 4:00 PM overlaps. Dashboard state was last updated November 16, so completion and reminder information may be stale.

items.label: Confirm Wave 2 recovery and coverage
items.detail: Jenn reports Tier 2 is cleared for deployment today; six remaining queues are planned for December 1-2. Confirm recovery and coverage with Thiago, including the audit of about 164 users missing language skills.

items.label: Check MHE approvals and pilot readiness
items.detail: Check today's requested approvals and provider onboarding with Mar. The pilot did not start November 20; its new date is to be set at Wednesday's touchpoint.

items.label: Follow up on the Power BI assignment
items.detail: The November 5 reporting request was unassigned and blocking the project for selling services to leads with ongoing cases. Check the request sent to Matthew; Leandro and Kevin were waiting for an assignment.

items.label: Follow up on EKM dependencies and timing
items.detail: Pilot stories passed grooming, but Legal capacity, approval governance, Salesforce migration and delivery dates remain open. Confirm ownership and timing ahead of the pilot.

items.label: Confirm Universal Intake project leadership
items.detail: Leo and Matthew are now named sponsors; confirm the project lead. The charter is due November 25, and automatic eligibility remains an open decision for Legal, IT and Intake.

items.label: Check the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: Saturday's notice identifies overdue Dominican Republic harassment prevention training and a new LeadUp Module 4A survey. Confirm their current status in Rippling; the dashboard state may not reflect recent completion.

items.label: Check the RFE MHE decision with Mar
items.detail: Mar's latest update asks Angel for four decisions on mandatory evaluations, declined or late evaluations, remediation scope and the close date. The design cannot go to IT until the first answer; sprint and developer remain unconfirmed.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Jhara 1:1
items.detail: Review portfolio status, roadblocks and next steps. The 11:00-11:30 AM block is reserved for weekly meeting slides.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Two tentative meetings overlap
items.detail: CM CoE/Product and the Amazon Connect standup both appear at 11:30 AM AST. The standup invitation says 3:00 PM ET, which conflicts with the calendar time; confirm the actual time and coverage. Noon to 1:00 PM is blocked.

items.label: 1:00 PM - Danny quarterly skip-level
items.detail: Prepare key wins, open risks and leadership decisions. EPMO TL catch-up follows at 2:00 PM.

items.label: 3:30 PM Nicolas; 4:00 PM portfolio conflict
items.detail: The CSC portfolio review overlaps the tentative Re-Open Cases closure meeting at 4:00 PM. Decide attendance or coverage. All times AST.

items.label: Check SMS outage and client impact
items.detail: IT disabled all outbound SMS Magic messages after reports of unexpected client texts, including a concern about requests for payment-card details. Confirm investigation, safe client communication and restoration status with the responsible teams.

items.label: Prepare Re-Open Cases closure decisions
items.detail: Astrid flagged unresolved contract or engagement-letter availability, payment rules, attorney approval and Intake Support scripts. Use the 4:00 PM alignment or arrange coverage to confirm owners and a closure date.

items.label: Sara is out through December 4
items.detail: Her coverage note routes time approvals and PTO to Danny and asks for legal delays or conflicting guidance to be escalated to him.

items.label: Wednesday - portfolio and CoE overlaps
items.detail: Thiago's 1:1 is at 10:30 AM. Legal portfolio review and Laura's 1:1 overlap at 3:30 PM; the CoE touchpoint overlaps focus time at 4:00 PM AST.
